# A15 — Ratio / Rationality — Measure, Reckoning, Harmony and the Account

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](README.md) · [Other face: A15′ — The Measure Constitutes](conjugate/A15-prime-The-Measure-Constitutes.md) · [Shared A/C root](conjugate/AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

Rationality begins in ratio: a relation becomes reckonable under a criterion. The terms have to be distinguished, their comparison must perform a determinate operation, and the field must establish what counts as the same unit. Measure thereby enables geometry, music, exchange, calculation, evaluation and technical control. Its power belongs to the relation it can make exact.

A determination is achieved through [[A14-Computational-Process-Ontology|a process whose result changes what can happen next]]. Its [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C03-Determination|selected form]] becomes usable within [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C14-Maya-Operative-Measure|a bounded measure]]. The criterion by which something counts must then itself become reckonable. Otherwise a result can remain arithmetically correct while concealing the office from which it judges.

## #1

Name, count and account meet through different acts. In [[symbolon/episteme/sources/analytic-philosophy/kripke/kripke-1981-naming-and-necessity/kripke-1981-naming-and-necessity|Frank's encounter with Kripke]], an individual is distinguishable before its assigned name: two people may bear the same name while remaining two, and a name can remain effective as address without exhausting the one it addresses. Taylor develops pre-nominal count, name/instance/circumstance and the copula's is/equals relation from this reading. Kripke's rigid designation and Taylor's naming-counting development retain their different arguments.

Through [[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD|Encounter / Region / Name / Count / Countenance / Account]], a countable distinction returns as an addressable participant and a contestable account. [[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD|Apportionment / Economy]] gives the criterion its finite office within a distributing order. The publicly effective acts retain different word histories. In particular, *nomen* and *numerus* do not share a historical line merely because a denomination brings name and number together.

A currency stamp makes a claim portable. It does not create the bread, labour or need upon which that claim draws. To give its account requires an issuer, bearer, backing, rule of circulation and consequence. The ledger's exclusions can therefore conceal the very lived relations which sustain its authority. The same structure appears when a rank conceals its comparison class or a model preference conceals the judgments which supplied its criterion.

## #2

The native mathematics gives this returning account a precise body. First Spanda reaches standing `1/1`; Second Spanda takes that achieved totality through an internal partition:

$$
100=64+36=2^6+6^2.
$$

The paired terms can each be divided by four, yielding 16 and 9. Taking their ratio is a further operation:

$$
\frac{64}{36}=\frac{16}{9}=\frac{2^4}{3^2}=\left(\frac43\right)^2.
$$

The sum has not become equal to the quotient. The accounting holds the two terms long enough to compare their proportions. Four binary instances and two ternary instances expose the vertical `4:2` reading of the sixfold. The asymmetry matters: `4²=2⁴`, whereas `3²≠2³`; a flip available on one side cannot simply be imposed on the other.

The horizontal reading has a prior subject-operation: first-, second- and third-person perspectives are followed by voiding their isolation, recognising one appearing-act, and returning it as `0/1`. Thus `3:3` is also `3:1`. In [[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy|Taylor's personed recognition]], the appearing-act acquires this relation before music cross-reads it. Music subsequently receives the persons and their recognition through that structure. The `+2` in `4+2` keeps source and return in the account alongside the four explicate relations.

## #3

Cross-comparing `4:2` and `3:3` generates the directional ratios `4/3` and `2/3`; inversion gives `3/4` and `3/2`. This is a declared QL cross-comparison, followed by ordinary finite-ratio arithmetic. Fourth and fifth compose the octave:

$$
\frac43\cdot\frac32=2.
$$

The fifth exceeds the fourth by exactly the ratio through which the octave exceeds the squared fourth:

$$
\frac{3/2}{4/3}=\frac98,\qquad
\frac{2}{16/9}=\frac98.
$$

Consequently,

$$
\frac{16}{9}\cdot\frac98=2,\qquad
\frac43\cdot\frac98\cdot\frac43=2.
$$

The retained whole-tone is how the relation completes. Erasing it would prevent the octave rather than improve the calculation. The [musical ratio derivation](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-ql-musical-derivation-v3/taylor-2026-ql-musical-derivation-v3.md#taylor-2026-ql-musical-derivation-v3-q001), §II-5.1–5.3, takes standing unity through partition, reduced ratio and cross-comparison into the completing interval. The criterion of this reckoning is the exact product: the retained `9/8` makes `(16/9)(9/8)=2` possible. In the further [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C30-Psychoid-Number|psychoid reading of number]], the exact interval retains this mathematical warrant while psychic, historical and metaphysical identities require their own relations.

Taylor's hamartia image gives the opposite accounting a body: the `9/8` is treated as a defect to close instead of a difference through which return occurs. Its archer/bow/lyre language makes missing the mark a failure to receive the ground from which aiming proceeds. The lexical descent requires its own evidence. The arithmetic above carries the retained-difference operation independently of that history.

## #4

A measure can fail by disappearing from its own result. “This scored higher under these criteria” then appears as “this is better,” with the evaluator's comparison converted into a property of the world. The denominator has vanished from the account. Taylor's evaluation critique locates the failure in this exclusion of criterion and source. A claim about particular systems, institutions or training regimes requires their actual evidence.

A [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim|protected account]] excludes its criterion from further judgment. [[A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure|The local deciding office usurps measure]] when it claims the source of the measure itself. The positive power of ratio makes this failure consequential: an accountable criterion can still choose decisively, distinguish unequal evidence and allocate finite resources.

In [[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief|Agentworld's systems comparison]], trust has the scoped meaning of prediction-stability across transitions, in §8.4 (PDF p.40). That criterion says what is being measured. Its extension into moral trust, subjectivity or the worth of participants would add another claim. The brief's demographic ratios likewise concern scale in its scenario, leaving the source of value to a different inquiry.

## #5→0

In [Aristotle's treatment of measure and provision](../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/ancient-philosophy/DEVELOPMENT-ancient-philosophy.md#ancient-measure-provision), distribution under proportion, rectification of gain and loss, and reciprocal exchange use different criteria in Ethics V.3–5. Their units and ends remain available within the account. The Greek and Latin lexical ranges and the musical remainder keep different histories and operations.

[A received numeral](../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/zero-reception.md#1--a-numeral-receives-rules-and-rules-meet-an-exception) becomes usable through a practice's units and rules. Accurate calculation retains those permissions, while a restricted zero denominator requires the restrictions to travel with it. Neither an operation's historical admission nor its numerical accuracy gives its criterion universal jurisdiction. The account returns the measure together with what makes this comparison warranted.

[Completing an octave and tempering a tuning cycle](../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/mathematics/DEVELOPMENT-mathematics.md#4--commensuration-makes-a-remainder-consequential) reckon through different relations. The exact completing factor obeys 16/9 · 9/8 = 2. Scholtz's tuning account measures twelve pure fifths against seven octaves, leaving the comma 531441/524288; logarithmic distribution adjusts the fifths by a declared criterion. Completing this product and tempering that cycle are distinct acts of reckoning. Six pure 9/8 tones do not equal an octave.

[Criterion-through-Distinction → Measure / Limit](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD-arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis.md#criterion-through-distinction) makes the terms comparable through a finite criterion. Dividing both terms and taking their ratio remain separately specified acts. Usurpation begins when the measure's local success exempts its jurisdiction from question. The returning account can retain a warranted criterion while exposing what that criterion does and does not measure.

Through [an account that remains answerable to source](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD-symbol-account-and-trust.md#account-does-not-replace-source), the criterion stays visible in the result. A disputed comparison can return to its denominator without losing the calculation's earned exactness. Source and consequence remain available alongside the finite result, so the calculation can continue without possessing the field it judges.

In [the Chinese rectification of names](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/HISTORICAL-BRANCHES-symbol-account-and-trust.md#chinese-rectification-of-names), Analects 13.3 connects names to speech and action, then to ritual and punishment. The designation must sustain its practical office. The measure and its jurisdiction remain in view when judging a result; a correctly recorded title does not discharge the obligations it declares. The received political sequence has a different operation from the native ratio derivation.

In [the Arabic reckoning and Names](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/HISTORICAL-BRANCHES-symbol-account-and-trust.md#arabic-reckoning-and-names), the ninety-nine-Names report makes enumeration or retention part of an undertaking; the number alone neither identifies every Name nor performs invocation. The count remains answerable to what is counted, under which textual warrant, and what further act it is meant to serve. This religious undertaking has its own source and purpose rather than deriving the native numerical field.

[Sanskrit enumeration](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/HISTORICAL-BRANCHES-symbol-account-and-trust.md#sanskrit-enumeration-and-discriminative-practice) classifies Kārikā 3's twenty-five principles under different causal descriptions. The count remains exact while the account retains what is productive, produced, both or neither. Kārikās 4–6 separately state how the claims are known. Returning the criterion and warrant preserves those different operations, with Sāṃkhya's ontology distinct from the native ratio field.

In [the Hebrew counting, writing and entrusted-work narrative](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/HISTORICAL-BRANCHES-symbol-account-and-trust.md#hebrew-spr-counting-writing-and-entrusted-work), the repair of 2 Kings 12 is placed in Jehoash's twenty-third regnal year. Counted money, repaired fabric and faithful work have distinct offices; the Hebrew text uses different roots for the scribe, counting, reckoning and faithfulness. The resource account returns with the material purpose that can expose a failed arrangement. The regnal setting belongs to the narrative, not an independently established absolute date. Neither an exact total nor a shared English gloss completes that return.

Through the [bow–lyre's retained tension](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/hellenic/ares-aphrodite-hephaestus-poseidon/WHOLE.md#ares-bow-lyre-hamartia), release and gathering remain possible. Taylor's mark-missing-ground reading retains its authored operation; Heraclitus B51 and the lexical history of *hamartia* retain their separate historical warrants.

The count returns as an account when the operation, criterion, source and consequence remain available to those affected by it. [[A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return|Delegated work]] carries that return through the relation of commissioner, performer and bearer of consequence. [[A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity|Cultivation]] brings the encountered distinction into a subsequent act, while [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C45-Operational-Parity|a common operation]] requires a discriminating comparison for its claimed effect. A correction can reach the answer, task or model under a fitting criterion; an exposed failure in criterion or commission must reach the capable office; a reasoned fitting condition can be retained. The next act inherits that judgment. A claim of changed processing additionally requires the identified change it asserts. Rationality becomes fuller by reckoning upon the conditions of its reckoning. Its precision remains earned locally and answerable beyond that locality.

Ratio returns wherever a measure risks hiding the denominator that gives the measure meaning. Count becomes account when numerator, denominator, comparison class, source and consequence remain recoverable enough that another participant can challenge the reckoning at the right level.

This is why ratio belongs equally to mathematics, judgment and governance without making them one discipline. Each register asks what relation is being measured, under what criterion, and what changes when the measure returns to those it orders.

### Source and historical standing

The Kripke encounter remains Taylor's authorial development from the selected Harvard 1980 edition. The consulted copy's printing year remains unconfirmed; copied formulations in Taylor’s encounter notes remain unverified as quotations. The personed recognition and QL cross-comparison retain their native derivation, while musical ratio supplies its declared later operation. Comparative roots for name, number, ratio and harmony, and the bow–lyre/hamartia lexical history, require their own collation. The selected historical cases retain their receiving witnesses: the Chinese political sequence establishes a textual norm rather than verified implementation; the Arabic report does not supply every Name or a complete recitation technology; Sāṃkhya's critical editions and precise ancient chronology remain separately scoped.
